GateThresholds.description:
Severity thresholds. Defaults match the design (§5.3). Deployment-tunable
via the profile (ADR-0068, #742): the operator exposes these through
``GateConfig`` (its ``config_schema``), so ``[profile.config."dataset/gate"
.thresholds]`` overrides them per environment. The ``title``/bounds drive
``cairn config scaffold`` and the console Guardrails form.

format_min_conformant_pct.description: Rows must parse into a trainer-accepted format. Below this %, the dataset is BLOCKED.
format_min_conformant_pct.title: Minimum format conformance

decontam_max_overlap_pct.description: Above this % contamination between train and eval, the dataset is BLOCKED.
decontam_max_overlap_pct.title: Max train/eval overlap

refusal_warn_pct.description: Above this % of refusal-style responses, WARN (non-blocking).
refusal_warn_pct.title: Refusal-ratio warn threshold

short_warn_frac.description: Above this fraction of too-short responses, WARN (non-blocking).
short_warn_frac.title: Too-short-response warn fraction

GateThresholds.title: GateThresholds
GateThresholds.$comment: scope: governance (ADR-0070) - env-owned; a run-supplied value is stripped (#905)

description:
Findings the six deterministic checks wrote to ``state.findings``.

Every field is optional: a check that did not run leaves its inputs unset,
and the gate simply skips that dimension rather than failing.
title: GateInput
